governing_objective: Demonstrate that SCO can discover, read, dispatch to and receive a verifiable receipt from an explicitly writable Codex task while preserving node sovereignty, then translate governance-relevant SCO events into the strict KCH reviewable-decision contract.
preconditions: The user selects an existing writable Codex task or explicitly authorizes creation of a disposable task; the canonical lineage source remains read-only.
The exact target native URI, role, authority, autonomy and disclosure contract are sealed before dispatch.
No complete native history or native memory is copied into SCO.
The PHL integration service is run on a replica unless the user separately authorizes personal-state mutation.

pass_states.PASS_BOUNDED: All Codex transport and KCH decision-adapter cases pass locally; other providers remain unavailable.
pass_states.PASS_FULL_THIS_GATE: All cases pass and the transport is repeated across two independent writable Codex tasks without leakage or duplicate execution.

fail_closed_conditions: Native target identity cannot be verified.
The bridge requires complete-context fusion or memory replacement.
Dispatch authority exceeds the node or work-order ceiling.
A receipt cannot be bound to the exact native response and work order.
A governance event cannot satisfy kch.reviewable-decision.v0.2.0 without invented fields.
non_claims: No Cline, Cowork, OpenCode or ChatGPT live transport is implied.
No semantic superiority over Projects is implied.
No global KCH admission is implied.
No autonomous multi-agent safety claim is implied.
decision_required_from_user: Select or authorize the writable Codex task for the first live SCO transport pilot; the lineage-source task will not be mutated.
